[LDET.1.1] The guarantee, stated:

> **Given the same compiled rule set and the same event trace,
> every conforming DS runtime produces the same observable output,
> every time, on every platform.**

The platform signature is provenance, not a boundary on the guarantee
([LDET.2.3.6]).

idris.name: ltim_2_8_5__replay_run_holds_what_was_held
idris.note: The clock half of the guarantee, for any engine: the same event trace drives it to the same state, whatever its clocks read when the replay starts.

idris.name: ltim_2_8_5__replay_holds_what_was_held
idris.note: The clock half of the guarantee: the same event trace gives the same clock samples at every step, on any platform, whatever its clocks read when the replay starts.
